payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed methods for building gazetteer resources from Wikipedia's knowledge base, specifically through the use of Wikidata and various processing techniques.

claims.text: Gazetteers can be built from Wikidata by processing official dumps into tuples of entities and types based on instance_of relationships.
Entity popularity is used to filter ambiguous entities in the gazetteer, retaining only the most popular types for each entity.
The GazSelfAttn approach enhances gazetteer representation by using self-attention and match span encoding, integrating these embeddings into neural models.
